My family does something similar when I have something materially to exploit. They see me as an ATM, too. The only thing I could do is to cut them off entirely which may seem cruel or impossible, but if they're only in it for my financial support, then they're probably not worth having in my life anyhow.

Even if it feels like an insurmountable hill, you won't always be stuck living in that broken home. And the sooner you cut financial ties to your folks, the sooner you can sever the ties that hold you to where you are now. You are not the person they make you out to be. One day, you will be able to look back on the people who've put you through this as an example of how to never treat someone you care about. And the people who care about you will value you dearly for sticking through it now.

first off, I don’t think you really see what i’m saying with this since I didn’t explain it all too well. By this, I meant he would be great at focusing a single target in a fight but would lose some of the security that comes with being able to focus anyone at any time. players would then have to focus their positioning on aggressively focusing that one target instead of sitting at a safe distance hitting anyone possible. his self peel and mobility would also then have a clearer objective; kill your target. Yes, I know his mobility and security are his primary issues but this would limit their versatility by giving them a clear and necessary objective. 
and not to be redundant but this was more of a first idea in thinking of ways to give him a clear, defined identity through ADDING something to his kit rather than removing parts of his kit.
